app.log.text:
Log window: 2026-10-12 09:00:00 to 10:59:54, services checkout-api, payment-svc, inventory-svc, plus deployer.

**Routine (all normal):** Health checks ok every ~30s on all three services. Cart and stock GETs returned 200 (cart ~10-475ms, stock ~4-119ms). Payment POSTs to provider bankgw returned 200 at 40-900ms. Metrics (DEBUG) were unremarkable: cpu 8-70%, mem 380-900MB.

**Events:**
- 09:45:11, 09:45:41, 09:46:11: inventory-svc health check FAILED: redis ping timeout (WARN). Health recovered by 09:46:30.
- 09:47:13: inventory-svc GET /api/v1/stock/SKU-88231 500, NullPointerException in StockMapper.toDto (req=6817dd174374). Single occurrence.
- 10:02:11: deployer deployed payment-svc 2.14.1 (commit 9f3c2ab) by ci-bot.
- 10:03:03 to 10:31:04: payment-svc failures. About 48 POST /api/v1/pay 503 "upstream timeout after 5000ms" (provider=bankgw). About 12 "unhandled exception in PaymentController.charge" (java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out at BankGatewayClient.charge:212, PaymentController.charge:88). About 13 WARN "db connection pool exhausted (max=50)". First WARN at 10:04:02. Health checks stayed ok throughout, and payment 200s still occurred intermittently (latencies up to ~850ms).
- 10:25:40: inventory-svc WARN disk usage 91% on /var/lib/inventory.
- 10:31:40: deployer rolled back payment-svc to 2.14.0 by oncall-asha.
- After 10:31:04 no further payment 503s or exceptions; payments returned 200 (latency ~40-850ms).

**Summary:** Payment-svc 2.14.1 caused bankgw read timeouts, DB pool exhaustion and 503s from 10:03 to 10:31. Rolled back to 2.14.0 at 10:31:40, after which errors stopped. Separate inventory issues: redis timeouts at 09:45-09:46, one 500 NPE at 09:47, and disk at 91% at 10:25.
